Class GameController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.gc06.mesos.controller.GameController
public class GameController extends Object
The main controller for the Mesos game. It handles incoming player requests, validates if it is the player's turn, and delegates the execution of the actions to the underlying game model and turn manager.

      playerNickname - The player performing the action.
